list.name: session
list.label: Session
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "session", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "shredstream_bench-session-pair", start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

options.content: Select a session and a time range covering the trial. Data shreds only. Negative delta means the candidate arrived earlier. Savings measures adding the candidate alongside the baseline, on shared shreds. Missing-delivery counts use a finite matching window. No contested samples means no latency comparison. Check `bench.py status` or the session's `status.json` for feed presence, observation loss, output errors, and completion. These panels are not stake-weighted; use `bench.py report --votes` for that analysis.

targets.query: from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "shredstream_bench-session-pair" and r.session == "${session}" and r.shred_type == "data" and r.leader == "ALL" and r._field == "contested") |> group() |> sum()

panels.title: Global comparison (counts and sums across selected windows)

targets.query: from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "shredstream_bench-session-pair" and r.session == "${session}" and r.shred_type == "data" and r.leader == "ALL") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "contested" or r._field == "candidate_faster" or r._field == "delta_sum_us" or r._field == "time_saved_sum_us") |> group(columns: ["leader", "_field"]) |> sum() |> group() |> pivot(rowKey: ["leader"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.contested > 0) |> map(fn: (r) => ({leader: r.leader, contested: r.contested, candidate_win_pct: 100.0 * float(v: r.candidate_faster) / float(v: r.contested), mean_delta_us: float(v: r.delta_sum_us) / float(v: r.contested), mean_savings_us: float(v: r.time_saved_sum_us) / float(v: r.contested)}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "shredstream_bench-session-pair" and r.session == "${session}" and r.shred_type == "data" and r.leader != "ALL" and r.leader != "unknown") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "contested" or r._field == "candidate_faster" or r._field == "delta_sum_us" or r._field == "time_saved_sum_us") |> group(columns: ["leader", "_field"]) |> sum() |> group() |> pivot(rowKey: ["leader"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> filter(fn: (r) => r.contested > 0 and r.contested >= int(v: "${min_contested}")) |> map(fn: (r) => ({leader: r.leader, contested: r.contested, candidate_win_pct: 100.0 * float(v: r.candidate_faster) / float(v: r.contested), mean_delta_us: float(v: r.delta_sum_us) / float(v: r.contested), mean_savings_us: float(v: r.time_saved_sum_us) / float(v: r.contested)})) |> sort(columns: ["contested"], desc: true) |> limit(n: 2000)

panels.title: Delivery coverage and clock anomalies (includes uncontested leaders)

targets.query: from(bucket: "${bucket}") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "shredstream_bench-session-pair" and r.session == "${session}" and r.shred_type == "data") |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "both_delivered" or r._field == "baseline_only" or r._field == "candidate_only" or r._field == "clock_anomalies") |> group(columns: ["leader", "_field"]) |> sum() |> group() |> pivot(rowKey: ["leader"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> sort(columns: ["leader"]) |> limit(n: 2000)
